name: music-project-delivery-guard
description: Guards a code-managed music workflow from brief and composition through independent review and digest-bound release.

interface.shortDescription: Compose, review, render, and prove coded music.
interface.longDescription: Orchestrates a brief-to-release Tone.js workflow with pinned external advisers, deterministic rendering, independent listening review, and digest-bound evidence.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $music-project-authoring to create a code-managed music project and hand the current render to $music-project-review before release.
